mounts.description: List of direct mount entries. Each entry defines where to mount, which map to use, and optional mount options.

point.description: Absolute path where the filesystem will be mounted (e.g., /mnt/nfs, /home)

map.description: Map file (absolute path or name under /etc/) containing mount entries, or a special map like +nis or file:server:/path

options.description: List of mount options for this entry (e.g., [intr, nosuid, rw])

enable_misc.description: Enable indirect mounting under /misc using /etc/auto.misc (commonly used for CDROM, floppies, etc.)
